question: A thin flat circular disc of radius $4.5$ cm is placed gently over the surface of water. If surface tension of water is $0.07\ \text{N m}^{-1}$, then the excess force required to take it away from the surface is :
solution:
Surface tension acts along the rim of the disc (the circumference in contact with water):
$$F = S \times 2\pi r = 0.07 \times 2 \times 3.14 \times 0.045 \approx 0.0198\ \text{N} = 19.8\ \text{mN}$$
